UI_IconsInventory_options_enableSmartDra: Select or move items the same way
UI_IconsInventory_options_enableSmartScr: Scrolling from Icons Inventory cycles containers
UI_IconsInventory_options_smallerHint: For smaller size go in UI/Interface menu and reduce the game's main font size. Needs relaunching the game.
